{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values in customer_age
missing_age = sales_df['customer_age'].isnull().sum()

# Check the data type of customer_age
dtype_age = sales_df['customer_age'].dtype

# Check for outliers or implausible values
min_age = sales_df['customer_age'].min()
max_age = sales_df['customer_age'].max()

missing_age, dtype_age, min_age, max_age"}
